description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ModelTreeAction' and several nested static classes representing different types of actions (entity queries, scripts, services) within a widget model tree in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles reading, executing, and managing actions related to widget tree nodes, including entity lookups, script execution, and service invocation.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction
classes.description: Abstract base class for actions performed on widget model tree nodes, including reading node actions, and nested classes for specific action types.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.EntityAnd
classes.description: Represents an entity query with 'AND' conditions, executing the query and setting the result list iterator on the model sub-node.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents an entity query based on a condition, executing the query and setting the result list iterator on the model sub-node.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.Script
classes.description: Represents a script execution action, running a script or simple method and updating the list iterator or context accordingly.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.Service
classes.description: Represents a service invocation, calling a service, processing results, and updating the context or model sub-node.

methods.name: readNodeActions
methods.description: Reads and creates a list of ModelAction objects from XML node actions.

methods.name: readSubNodeActions
methods.description: Reads and creates a list of ModelAction objects from XML sub-node actions.

methods.name: getModelSubNode
methods.description: Returns the model sub-node associated with this action.

methods.name: getModelTree
methods.description: Returns the model tree associated with this action.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations on this action.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the specific action logic, such as querying entities, running scripts, or invoking services.
